items.description: Redis source install: install build tools (gcc, make, build-essential), download redis-3.2.11.tar.gz, extract, compile (make clean && make), install to /usr/local/bin; skip if binary already exists
items.notes: install.rb content merged into redis_install.yml (source build path)

items.description: Redis ulimit setup (Debian only): deploy /etc/pam.d/su template and /etc/pam.d/sudo cookbook_file; set redis user file handle limit to 10032 via /etc/security/limits.d/redis.conf
items.notes: ulimit.rb content merged into redis_install.yml (PAM limits configuration)

items.description: Disable OS default Redis service: stop and disable redis-server (Debian) or redis (RHEL) to avoid conflicts with source-installed redis@6379

items.description: Redis configuration: create redis system user/group, create /etc/redis, /var/lib/redis, /var/run/redis/6379 directories, render redis.conf and redis@.service templates, create tmpfiles.d entry, run systemctl daemon-reload
items.notes: configure.rb content merged into redis_configure.yml

items.description: Enable and start redis@6379 systemd service; also covers redisio::default (apt update, build_essential, orchestration of install/configure/enable sub-tasks)

items.description: Redisio default orchestration: apt update, install build tools, call install/disable_os_default/configure sub-tasks
items.notes: redisio default.rb orchestration merged into redis_install.yml

items.description: Redis configuration file template: port, requirepass, backuptype, datadir, loglevel, syslog settings, databases, maxclients, appendfsync, hz, tcpbacklog, timeout, keepalive — rendered to /etc/redis/6379.conf
items.notes: Converted ERB template to Jinja2. All ERB variables prefixed with @ converted to redis_ prefixed Jinja2 variables.

items.description: Redis systemd template unit file: ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/redis-server, user=redis, group=redis, LimitNOFILE=10032 — rendered to /lib/systemd/system/redis@6379.service
items.notes: Converted ERB to Jinja2. Variables renamed with redis_ prefix for clarity.
